test_py_batched_tfds: test the py_batched_tfds function to create a batched TensorFlow Datasets iterator with context_size and batch_size
test_py_noam_pack: test the _NoamPack class to pack multiple grain records into fixed-size context windows without padding
test_py_batched_tfds_noam_packed: test py_batched_tfds with NOAM_PACKED preprocessing to produce batches with no PAD_ID tokens
test_py_batched_tfds_padded: test py_batched_tfds with PADDED preprocessing to produce batches containing PAD_ID tokens
test_get_in_out: test the get_in_out function to generate input, output, and weight arrays for language model training
